notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest and/or basic Plains.
description:
Activate a basic Forest or Plains by tapping it, adding {G/W}
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Lurrus, untapping the Forest or Plains.
Optionally, you may repeat steps 1 and 2, tapping Saffi instead.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {G/W}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.
This combo nets infinite colored mana if you control a basic Forest and a basic Plains, or infinite mana lands you control can produce otherwise.
